description: Vyapar Mitra business dictionary - auto-built from the Business_Adv knowledge base (app/seed.py) plus startup essentials. Each entry has a plain-language meaning and a 'use it' tip. Loaded by app/dictionary.py and shown in the Dictionary tab.

entries.meaning_simple: Money you need day-to-day to run the business - stock, wages, transport - before customers pay you.
entries.use_it: Keep 3 months of fixed costs aside. If you run short, a KCC / MUDRA / TReDS advance is cheaper than a moneylender.

entries.meaning_simple: Something valuable (land, gold, machine) you promise the bank so it gives you a loan.
entries.use_it: No property? Ask the bank for CGTMSE-covered or MUDRA loans - they need no collateral.

entries.meaning_simple: A discount on loan interest given by the government - you pay less interest.
entries.use_it: Repay on time to keep the subvention (e.g. effective ~4% on KCC, 7% subsidy on SVANidhi).

entries.meaning_simple: Selling your unpaid customer bills to a bank at a small discount so you get cash now instead of waiting 60-90 days.
entries.use_it: Register on RXIL / M1xchange / Invoicemart and upload the buyer's accepted invoice.

entries.meaning_simple: The movement of money in and out. Profit on paper means nothing if cash comes late.
entries.use_it: Record every sale and expense daily (Khatabook / notebook). Collect dues before giving new credit.

entries.meaning_simple: Free online MSME registration using Aadhaar + PAN. It is the gate-pass for almost every MSME benefit.
entries.use_it: Register at udyamregistration.gov.in. Informal micro units can use the Udyam Assist Platform.

entries.meaning_simple: Online portal where micro/small suppliers complain when buyers delay payment beyond 45 days.
entries.use_it: File with your Udyam number at samadhaan.msme.gov.in. Interest is 3x the RBI bank rate.

related: Core compliance calendar for Indian companies
entries.meaning_simple: One national tax on most goods and services. You must register above Rs 40 lakh (goods) / Rs 20 lakh (services), or for inter-state / e-commerce sales.
entries.use_it: Register at gst.gov.in. Small units can pick the Composition scheme (up to Rs 1.5 cr) for flat tax + simple returns.

entries.meaning_simple: Official Startup India certificate that unlocks tax, patent and procurement benefits.
entries.use_it: Apply at startupindia.gov.in with incorporation certificate + note on innovation.

entries.meaning_simple: Eligible startups pay zero income tax on profits for any 3 years out of the first 10.
entries.use_it: Get the Inter-Ministerial Board certificate after DPIIT recognition.

entries.meaning_simple: National Agriculture Market - online portal linking mandis so you can see live prices and sell beyond your local mandi.
entries.use_it: Register at enam.gov.in or the e-NAM app, or at the mandi gate.

entries.meaning_simple: Government-regulated wholesale market where farmers sell to traders through auction.
entries.use_it: Compare modal prices on agmarknet.gov.in for 2-3 nearby mandis before you load the truck.

related: ONDC - sell online without big marketplace fees
entries.meaning_simple: Government e-Marketplace - sell goods and services directly to government departments.
entries.use_it: Register as seller at gem.gov.in with Aadhaar, PAN, Udyam and bank details.

related: ONDC - sell online without big marketplace fees
entries.meaning_simple: Open network that lets small shops list products once and get orders from many buyer apps with lower commission.
entries.use_it: Join via any ONDC seller app listed on ondc.org (Paytm, Pincode etc.).

entries.meaning_simple: Importer-Exporter Code - a one-time DGFT number you need to import or export anything.
entries.use_it: Get it online same-day at dgft.gov.in, then join an Export Promotion Council.

entries.meaning_simple: Scheme that refunds hidden central/state taxes built into exported goods.
entries.use_it: Claim it through your shipping bill - ask your CHA / export council.

entries.meaning_simple: Direct Benefit Transfer - subsidy or cash sent straight to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
entries.use_it: Seed Aadhaar with your bank account and complete e-KYC so PM-KISAN and subsidies do not fail.

entries.meaning_simple: Insurance where the farmer pays only 2% / 1.5% / 5% premium and government pays the rest.
entries.use_it: Enrol via bank / CSC / pmfby.gov.in before the season cut-off. Report loss within 72 hrs on the app.

entries.meaning_simple: Part of your project cost the government pays (e.g. 15-35% in PMEGP) so your loan is smaller.
entries.use_it: Apply on the PMEGP e-portal (KVIC). Complete EDP training so the bank sanctions faster.

entries.meaning_simple: Free lab report of your soil's nutrients + which fertiliser dose your crop needs.
entries.use_it: Get it from the agriculture office / KVK. It cuts fertiliser cost and raises yield.

related: Join or form an FPO (Farmer Producer Organisation)
entries.meaning_simple: Farmer Producer Organisation - a company of farmers that buys inputs together and sells together for better prices.
entries.use_it: Ask NABARD / SFAC / district agriculture office about FPOs in your block.

entries.meaning_simple: Zero Defect Zero Effect - quality + green certificate for MSMEs (Bronze / Silver / Gold) with heavy subsidy.
entries.use_it: Apply at zed.msme.gov.in. It helps win large-buyer and export orders.

entries.meaning_simple: Growing using your own savings and customer money, without outside investors.
entries.use_it: Best for the first 6-12 months. Take grants (SISFS, state policy) before giving equity.

entries.meaning_simple: A wealthy individual who puts Rs 10-50 lakh into an early startup for a small share.
entries.use_it: Approach only after 3-5 paying customers + a 10-12 slide deck with CAC, LTV and margins.

entries.meaning_simple: Funds that invest crores for fast growth - they expect 10x returns, so only for large markets.
entries.use_it: Do not chase VC for a small local business - use MUDRA, CGTMSE or revenue-based financing instead.

entries.meaning_simple: Minimum Viable Product - the smallest version customers will pay for, built to test demand fast.
entries.use_it: Interview 20-30 customers, launch a waitlist or pilot with 3-5 paying users before building fully.

entries.meaning_simple: CAC = cost to get one customer. LTV = money one customer brings over their lifetime. LTV must be 3x+ CAC.
entries.use_it: Track both monthly. If CAC > LTV/3, fix pricing or channel before scaling ads.

entries.meaning_simple: Whether you make money on ONE sale: price minus all direct costs (product, delivery, payment fee, returns).
entries.use_it: Prove positive unit economics before raising funds - investors ask for it first.

entries.meaning_simple: A loan that later converts into company shares - how SISFS gives up to Rs 50 lakh for scaling.
entries.use_it: Apply via seedfund.startupindia.gov.in to up to 3 incubators.

entries.meaning_simple: Government buyers must prefer MSEs and startups in tenders (price + payment relaxations).
entries.use_it: Quote on GeM with Udyam + DPIIT certificates to claim the preference.
